blocks.text: Al-Muhaymin The Ever-Watchful Witness is found in one place in the Qur'aan where Allaah says,

He is Allah than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah! (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.

The meaning of Al-Muhaymin The Ever-Watchful Witness is the One who sees the hidden affairs, that which the chests conceal, the One who encompasses everything with His knowledge, the One who Witnesses the deeds of creation. The Watcher over their speech and deeds. Nothing is hidden from Him of their deeds at all. Not a speck of a seed in the earth or the heavens is hidden from Him.
As for the Name Al-Muheet The All-Encompassing, it is found in many places.
And Allah is Ever Encompassing all things.
Surely, Allah surrounds all that they do.
It is a Name that indicates Allaah encompasses everything through His knowledge, power and control.
Encompassing knowledge – not a speck of a seed from His creation is hidden from Him.
Encompassing power – nothing is impossible for Him to do in the earth or in the heaven.
Encompassing control – no one can escape or go missing from Him.
O assembly of jinns and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allah)!
This means that you will not be able to escape from Allaah's command or pre-destination because He encompasses everything by His knowledge, power and control.

keyPoints: Al-Muhaymin is found in one place in the Qur'aan (Hashr 59:23).
Al-Muhaymin is the One who sees the hidden affairs and what the chests conceal, encompasses everything with His knowledge, and witnesses and watches over the speech and deeds of creation.
Al-Muheet is found in many places and indicates that Allaah encompasses everything through His knowledge, power and control.
Encompassing knowledge: not a speck of a seed is hidden from Him; encompassing power: nothing is impossible for Him; encompassing control: no one can escape or go missing from Him.
No one can escape Allaah's command or pre-destination because He encompasses everything (Rahmaan 55:33).

evidence.text: ...the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme.
And Allah is Ever Encompassing all things.

recall.a: The One who sees the hidden affairs and what the chests conceal, encompasses everything with His knowledge, and witnesses the deeds of creation, the Watcher over their speech and deeds.

recall.q: Where is Al-Muhaymin found in the Qur'aan?

recall.a: That Allaah encompasses everything through His knowledge, power and control.

recall.q: Explain the three aspects of Allaah's encompassing.
recall.a: Knowledge: not a speck of a seed is hidden from Him. Power: nothing is impossible for Him in the earth or heaven. Control: no one can escape or go missing from Him.

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite to show that no one can escape Allaah's command?
recall.a: Rahmaan 55:33: 'O assembly of jinns and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass (them)!...'
